text:
marco: Quick notice  planning a 3h rolling window for phoenix-pool to apply NIC microcode + fan-profile tweaks. Window: 2026-05-02 02:30-05:30 UTC. We'll do small cohorts (2 racks) with a light warmbackfill strategy. Expected capacity hit ~12-18% during each rack rotation.

anya: Thx. Can we avoid touching racks that currently host pinned dedicated customers?

marco: Yes  we'll exclude racks with "dedicated=reserved" label. Those are out-of-scope.

kevin: Canary plan? Want explicit metric gates.

marco: Canary: rack px-canary-a then px-canary-b. Gates: error rate moving 5m window <=0.4% above baseline, tail latency (p99) <= +80ms, no OOMs or stateful pod evictions. If any gate trips we stop and run rollback microcode on that rack.

kevin: Good. I'll add a synthetic steady-load probe (replay qps ~10% of normal) hitting model endpoints during canary and first two cohorts.

mareco: (typo) marco: noted :)

ops-bot: [maintenance scheduled] id=maint-2026-177654, queue=#phoenix-maint, window=2026-05-02T02:30:00Z/2026-05-02T05:30:00Z

tareq: Cost note  if we need cross-region warmbackfill to eu-west1 it will be ~€1.1k for 3 GPUs for 3h. Finance spot-approve?

finance-bot: finance approval pending. Please add cost center tag: ops:phoenix-0526.

kevin: Technical preflight I propose:
```
# node inventory
kubectl get nodes -l pool=phoenix-pool -o wide
# confirm reserved rack exclusion
curl -s https://infra-api/racks?pool=phoenix-pool | jq '.[] | select(.labels.dedicated=="reserved")'
# prefix-cache prime check
curl -s https://internal-admin/cache-status?pool=phoenix | jq .hit_rate
```

anya: Also: confirm storage attach/detach timings for stateful sets. We had a slow detach last time.

marco: Good call. Add a 3m wait after cordon before drain for storage detach.

kevin: I'll push an autoscaler patch to allow +4 nodes temporarily, and will set scale-down conservatively to 30m. After the window we revert the max nodes.

marco: Operational timeline (UTC):
- 01:00 ops preflight and inventory checks
- 02:00 final go/no-go sync in #phoenix-maint
- 02:30 start canary px-canary-a (cordon -> soft-drain -> microcode -> reboot -> prefix-cache prime)
- 02:45 verify canary metrics 02:45-02:55
- 03:00 if ok, roll two racks every 25m, max concurrent racks=2
- 05:20 final validation + scale-down revert
- 05:30 close window

kevin: Add routing fallback: if phoenix aggregate p95 >250ms route new requests to eu-west1 serving cluster. I can add a temporary rule in the router.

anya: Customer comms: I'll post short note on status.redwood.com and ping dedicated customers via mail-merge. Message will warn about short latency blips and note dedicated customers excluded.

marco: preflight checklist (30m before): run the inventory + prefix-cache check + storage detach smoke. Post results in thread.

ops-bot: [maintenance starting] maint-2026-177654 started at 02:32 UTC. canary rack px-canary-a cordon issued.

kevin: Canary started. synthetic probe injected. Initial p99 delta +22ms, errors stable at baseline.

anya: Watching storage detach times ~45s for stateful-01, acceptable.

marco: Proceed to microcode apply on px-canary-a. Reminder: keep the BMC watch open.

ops-bot: px-canary-a microcode flash complete, reboot scheduled 02:40 UTC.

kevin: Post-reboot checks: p99 +35ms, errors flat, cache hit rates down 2% for 5m then returned. Canary green.

marco: Proceeding with two-rack batches. Rate limit: don't start second cohort until previous rack fully rejoined and prefix-cache hit >85%.

kevin: Noted. Router fallback in place at 03:15 UTC in case aggregate p95 breaches threshold.

finance-bot: cost center ops:phoenix-0526 tagged for any cross-region instances.

anya: No major customer pages. small spike in tail latencies during warmbackfill on first cohort but within gates.

marco: Mid-run reminder: do not exceed 2 concurrent racks. If storage detach time >120s abort and escalate.

ops-bot: [maintenance progress] 6/10 racks completed. current capacity impact approx 14%.

kevin: Observed transient pod reschedule count +1 for a daemonset on rack-03 but it recovered, no evictions.

marco: Good. Keep an eye on token-cost meter (Optimize flagged higher token counts during prefix re-prime). Capture token delta.

ops-bot: [maintenance complete] maint-2026-177654 closed at 05:35 UTC. Summary: canary pass, all 10 targeted racks rolled, transient p99 bumps observed, no stateful evictions, no cross-region backfill required. Postmortem draft incoming.

anya: I'll assemble metrics (p95/p99, error %, storage detach times, prefix-cache hit rate, token delta) and drop links to dashboards in the postmortem.

marco: Thanks all. Postmortem should include a short note on possible follow-up: schedule longer prefix-cache priming during low-traffic weekend to avoid small p99 spikes.

oncall-scheduler: oncall was tareq for the window, acked and available.

kevin: I'll revert autoscaler limits in 30m if no late regressions.

marco: Closing notes: tag invoices to ops:phoenix-0526, and leave the router rule for 1h in case of late tail events.

anya: Great work everyone. :partyparrot:
